title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Firewall Policy module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-firewallpolicy'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

application_rule_collection.type: map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this application rule collection. action = string #(Required) The action to take for the application rules in this collection. Possible values are Allow and Deny. priority = number #Required) The priority of the application rule collection. The range is 100 - 65000. rule = map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this rule. description = string #(Optional) The description which should be used for this rule. source_addresses = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of source IP addresses (including CIDR, IP range and *). source_ip_groups = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of source IP groups. destination_addresses = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of destination IP addresses (including CIDR, IP range and *). destination_fqdns = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of destination FQDNs. Conflicts with destination_urls. terminate_tls = bool #(Optional) Boolean specifying if TLS shall be terminated (true) or not (false). Must be true when using destination_urls. Needs Premium SKU for Firewall Policy. web_categories = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of web categories to which access is denied or allowed depending on the value of action above. Needs Premium SKU for Firewall Policy. protocols = list(object({ type = string #(Required) Protocol type. Possible values are Http and Https. port = number #(Required) Port number of the protocol. Range is 0-64000. })) })) }))
application_rule_collection.description: (Optional) List of Application rule collection for the Azure Firewall Policy

auto_learn_private_ranges_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether enable auto learn private ip range

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dnsservers.description: (Required) A list of custom DNS servers' IP addresses.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

insight_setting.type: map(object({ enabled = bool default_log_analytics_workspace_id = string retention_in_days = number log_analytics_workspace = map(object({ log_analytics_workspace_id = string firewall_location = string })) }))
insight_setting.description: (Optional) logging and monitoring setting for Azure firewall Policy object({ enabled = (Required) Whether the insights functionality is enabled for this Firewall Policy. default_log_analytics_workspace_id = (Required) The ID of the default Log Analytics Workspace that the Firewalls associated with this Firewall Policy will send their logs to, when there is no location matches in the log_analytics_workspace. retention_in_days = (Required) The log retention period in days. log_analytics_workspace = (Required) A list of log_analytics_workspace block as defined below. log_analytics_workspace_id = (Required) The ID of the Log Analytics Workspace that the Firewalls associated with this Firewall Policy will send their logs to when their locations match the firewall_location. firewall_location = (Required) The location of the Firewalls, that when matches this Log Analytics Workspace will be used to consume their logs. })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

intrusion_detection_setting.type: map(object({ mode = string private_ranges = list(string) signature_overrides = map(object({ signature_id = number signature_state = string })) traffic_bypass = map(object({ name = string protocol = string description = string destination_addresses = list(string) destination_ip_groups = list(string) destination_ports = list(string) source_addresses = list(string) source_ip_groups = list(string) })) }))
intrusion_detection_setting.description: (Optional) IDPS setting for Azure firewall Policy object({ mode = (Required) In which mode you want to run intrusion detection: Off, Alert or Deny. private_ranges = (Required) A list of Private IP address ranges to identify traffic direction. By default, only ranges defined by IANA RFC 1918 are considered private IP addresses. signature_overrides = (Required) One or more signature_overrides blocks as defined below. signature_id = (Required) 12-digit number (id) which identifies your signature. signature_state = (Required) state can be any of Off, Alert or Deny. traffic_bypass = (Required) One or more traffic_bypass blocks as defined below. name = (Required) The name which should be used for this bypass traffic setting. protocol = (Required) The protocols any of ANY, TCP, ICMP, UDP that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. description = (Required) The description for this bypass traffic setting. destination_addresses = (Required) Specifies a list of destination IP addresses that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. destination_ip_groups = (Required) Specifies a list of destination IP groups that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. destination_ports = (Required) Specifies a list of destination IP ports that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. source_addresses = (Required) Specifies a list of source addresses that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. source_ip_groups = (Required) Specifies a list of source IP groups that shall be bypassed by intrusion detection. })

nat_rule_collection.type: map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this NAT rule collection. action = string #(Required) The action to take for the NAT rules in this collection. Currently, the only possible value is Dnat. priority = number #Required) The priority of the NAT rule collection. The range is 100 - 65000. rule = map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this rule. protocols = list(string) #(Required) Specifies a list of network protocols this rule applies to. Possible values are TCP, UDP. source_addresses = list(string) # (Optional) Specifies a list of source IP addresses (including CIDR, IP range and *). source_ip_groups = list(string) # (Optional) Specifies a list of source IP groups. destination_address = string # (Optional) The destination IP address (including CIDR). destination_ports = list(string) # (Optional) Specifies a list of destination ports. Only one destination port is supported in a NAT rule. translated_fqdn = string # (Optional) Specifies the translated FQDN. translated_port = number # (Required) Specifies the translated port. })) }))
nat_rule_collection.description: (optional) List of NAT rule collection for the Azure Firewall Policy

network_rule_collection.type: map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this network rule collection. action = string #(Required) The action to take for the network rules in this collection. Possible values are Allow and Deny. priority = number #(Required) The priority of the network rule collection. The range is 100 - 65000. rule = map(object({ name = string #(Required) The name which should be used for this rule. protocols = list(string) #(Required) Specifies a list of network protocols this rule applies to. Possible values are Any, TCP, UDP, ICMP. destination_ports = list(string) #(Required) Specifies a list of destination ports. source_addresses = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of source IP addresses (including CIDR, IP range and *). source_ip_groups = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of source IP groups. destination_addresses = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of destination IP addresses (including CIDR, IP range and *) or Service Tags. destination_ip_groups = list(string) #(Optional) Specifies a list of destination IP groups. destination_fqdns = list(string) # (Optional) Specifies a list of destination FQDNs. })) }))
network_rule_collection.description: (Optional) List of Network rule collection for the Azure Firewall Policy

priority.description: (Required) The priority of the Firewall Policy Rule Collection Group. The range is 100-65000.

private_ip_ranges.description: (Required) A list of private IP ranges to which traffic will not be SNAT

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Required) The SKU Tier of the Firewall Policy. Possible values are Standard, Premium and Basic

sql_redirect_allowed.description: (Optional) Whether SQL Redirect traffic filtering is allowed. Enabling this flag Requires no rule using ports between 11000-11999

state.description: (Optional) state can be any of Off, Alert or Deny

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

threat_intelligence_setting.description: (Optional)threat intelligence IDPS setting for Azure firewall Policy object({ threat_intelligence_allowlist_fqdn = (Required) A list of FQDNs that will be skipped for threat detection. threat_intelligence_allowlist_ip_address = (Required) A list of IP addresses or CIDR ranges that will be skipped for threat detection. })

fwpolicy_collection_group_id.description: The name of the firewall policy rule collection group id.

fwpolicy_collection_group_name.description: The name of the firewall policy rule collection group name.

id.description: The ID of the firewall policy.

name.description: The name of the firewall policy.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Firewallpolicy' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
